name: Makoto Riri
source:
A rich girl who is childhood friends with both [url=/c167744]Hajime[/url] and [url=/c166986]Kureha[/url]. She looks relatively normal at first glance, but deep down, she's a twisted girl who hates people who act lovey-dovey and virgins, and constantly fantasizes about being raped. However, she doesn't want any stranger to do it to her, rather the only person she wants to be raped by is Hajime, who also has twisted sex fantasies of his own.

She's the type of a heroine who shouldn't exist in a pure love eroge.
